outcome.description: After an eight-day bench trial, the court held Garmong prevailed on its breach-of-contract claim against EdgeRock for $943,042.64 plus interest and costs, with lien foreclosure for the same amount (Fox separately won $1,301,531.37 against EdgeRock). On transfer the Indiana Supreme Court limited the construction liens to work benefiting each lot (invalidating Garmong's lien on EdgeRock's lots and reducing its lien on ZPS's lots to $520,509.70) and addressed mortgage priority; the in personam money judgment against EdgeRock on the contract claim was not disturbed.
outcome.finalNote: In personam contract judgment undisturbed; lien security narrowed on transfer.

source.caseName: EdgeRock Development, LLC, ZPS Westfield, LLC, and First Bank Richmond v. C.H. Garmong & Son, Inc., Signworks, Inc., and Fox Contractors Corp.
source.court: Indiana Supreme Court (on transfer from the Court of Appeals), on appeal from the Hamilton Superior Court 5
